title: BSU Rector Meets with Assumption University Representatives

blocks.text: A meeting between the rector, professor Mirlan Dyldaev, and a delegation from one of Thailand’s leading universities, Assumption University, took place at the Bishkek State University named after Academician K. Karasaev.

The delegation included:• Dr. Gao Li — Assistant Vice President of Assumption University, responsible for educational innovation, international cooperation and graduate studies;• Dr. Kongrit Chatpathomrak — representative of Assumption University;• Mr. Chen Kang — an employee of the official office of Assumption University in China.
The meeting was also attended by Daurov Khusey Shimarovich, Chairman of the Dungan Association of Kazakhstan, President of the New Silk Road public foundation.
During the meeting, issues of cooperation in the field of academic exchanges, joint scientific and educational programs were discussed.
